xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #4067

plan.title: bug(design-critique): bind cross-family panel seats and CLI launchers before dispatch

narratives.Description: bug(design-critique): bind cross-family panel seats and CLI launchers before dispatch
narratives.Overview: Implement the smallest dispatch-layer change that records the declared model family for N>=3 sibling seats before spawn, rejects same-family-only panels with a re-seat or halt recovery, probes available claude/codex CLIs for Grok Build cross-family seats, and offers paste-ready dispatch only when a required CLI is unavailable. Preserve the existing operator verb, worktree isolation, ceilings, and non-goals. Add a focused regression fixture for the Grok parent with claude and codex on PATH.

references.title: Issue #4067: cross-family panel composition and Grok Build CLI dispatch

acceptance.derived_reason: derived from the five acceptance criteria in Issue #4067 before product edit

clauses.text: An N>=3 panel-deposit or sibling-seat record names three families before the first sibling spawn.
A same-family sibling set cannot be leaned; its recovery is to re-seat or halt.
A Grok Build parent with claude and codex on PATH CLI-spawns those other-family seats, with paste-ready output only as the fallback when a named CLI is unavailable.
A regression or fixture covers the Grok parent plus PATH claude/codex case without a paste-ready-first path.
A dispatch-composition miss offers or files a prevention issue under the existing operator workflow.
